PullRequest.Title: chat: disable Add Models for the remote Copilot harness
PullRequest.Body:

Ref #340335

## Context

When the Copilot harness runs on a remote agent host, it can't use extension-provided BYOK models. That happens in a remote window (SSH, WSL, Dev Containers, tunnels) or with a remote agent host (`remote-…-copilot` session types). The picker still offered **Add Models...**, which opened the Language Models editor. There users could add or show BYOK models that never appeared in the picker, so the flow was a dead end. This was reported on [r/GithubCopilot](https://www.reddit.com/r/GithubCopilot/comments/1xbllbj/cant_add_byok_models_to_copilot_agent_harness/) by a user on Remote SSH.

## Changes

- **Model picker:** in the remote Copilot harness, **Add Models...** is shown disabled. Its tooltip reads "BYOK models aren't supported in remote Copilot sessions", and clicking it does nothing.
- **Language Models editor:** when the editor is scoped to that harness, its **Add Models** button is disabled with the same tooltip.
- **Local harness:** unchanged, including in remote windows.
- **Shared rule:** `getAddModelsUnavailableReason` returns the reason only for a Copilot agent-host session type that is a remote agent host session type or runs in a remote window. This matches the existing remote BYOK chat-input notice.
- **Toolbar buttons:** `ITabBarAction` gains an optional `disabledReason`. The button uses `aria-disabled` rather than the HTML `disabled` attribute, so it stays focusable and hoverable. The reason is exposed as its tooltip and `aria-description`, and the button is styled with `disabledForeground` and no hover highlight.

## How to test

1. Configure a BYOK provider (for example, Custom Endpoint).
2. Open a remote window. Locally, `./scripts/code.sh --folder-uri=vscode-remote://test+test/<abs-path>` works after `npm run gulp node`.
3. In Chat, select the **Copilot** harness and open the model picker. **Add Models...** is dimmed, its tooltip explains why, and clicking it does nothing.
4. Run **Chat: Manage Language Models** from that chat. The **Add Models** button is disabled with the same tooltip.
5. Switch to the **Local** harness in the same window. **Add Models...** is enabled.

## Validation

- `npm run typecheck-client`: passed
- `./scripts/test.sh --reporter dot --run src/vs/platform/actionWidget/test/browser/tabbedActionListWidget.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/widget/input/modelPicker/modelPickerTabbedWidget.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/widget/input/modelPicker/modelPickerItems.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/widget/input/modelPicker/modelPickerActionItem.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/widget/input/modelPicker/modelPickerTelemetry.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/widget/input/modelPicker/modelPickerLocalModelItems.test.ts --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/chat/test/browser/modelPicker.test.ts`: passed (318 tests, including 3 new)
- `npm run eslint -- <changed .ts files>`: passed
- `node build/stylelint.ts <changed .css files>`: passed
- Pre-commit hygiene: passed
- Manual check in a test-resolver remote window: steps 3 to 5 above behaved as described

Not tested: a real SSH host, and the Agents window with a remote agent host. Both are covered by the shared rule and its unit test, but neither was run live.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open the chat model picker in a remote Copilot harness
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing picker show path gathers model arrays and renders the tabbed picker. The diff adds two session-type string predicates, one remote-authority read, and disabled-state DOM attributes before rendering; no asynchronous work must complete.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Model count controls the pre-existing picker construction. The added unavailable-reason check is O(1) and does not run per model.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single synchronous UI invocation per picker open; no queue, fan-out, or newly scheduled work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is introduced or bypassed. Cold and warm picker opens perform the same constant-time added check; existing model data and picker behavior are unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed call path and helper implementation were inspected directly and contain only string parsing, localization lookup on the disabled branch, and DOM state setup.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact picker model counts vary, but the changed work is independent of that count.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The change adds constant work and, when disabled, prevents the pre-existing manage-model command from running.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open or re-scope the Language Models editor for a chat harness
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing command enables the chat extension if needed and opens the editor before setSessionType runs. The diff then stores the session type and refreshes only the Add Models button; remote Copilot sessions return early before vendor filtering and dropdown-action construction.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Enable/update the running chat extension before opening the editor when required.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most once per Manage Language Models command invocation, subject to the existing enabled state.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same extension enablement/update path ran before every relevant editor-open command prior to this diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Pre-existing command work must finish before the editor is opened; the changed setSessionType/updateAddModelsButton logic runs afterward and does not add or repeat this boundary.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: For enabled contexts, the added refresh can filter the registered vendor list and rebuild dropdown actions once per explicit editor re-scope; in the targeted remote Copilot context it returns before that O(vendor-count) work. Re-scoping occurs per user command, not per model row or frame.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Serialized by the awaited command/editor-open path. The added button refresh is synchronous and does not start concurrent work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache behavior changes. Vendor data comes from the existing service; remote unavailable state skips consuming it rather than invalidating or duplicating it.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: callers, widget construction order, refresh listeners, and the synchronous helper were traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The number of registered vendors and repeated editor-open commands varies, but the extra refresh is user-driven and bounded; the targeted remote path is cheaper than before.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The only newly invoked refresh is bounded to editor scoping, and the remote branch avoids existing vendor/action work.

Scenarios.Scenario: Render disabled tab-bar actions in tabbed action widgets
Scenarios.CriticalPath: During the existing synchronous widget render loop, each action receives a class, ARIA attributes, and a tooltip selected from already available strings. Managed hover ownership remains in the existing renderDisposables store.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Cost grows linearly with the pre-existing number of tab-bar actions, adding only constant attribute/class operations per action. The reviewed model picker contributes one Add Models action.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single synchronous DOM render pass; no asynchronous work or concurrency is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is involved. Each widget render already reconstructs action buttons and disposes prior render resources.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the complete changed render loop and disposal ownership were inspected.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Other consumers may have different action counts, but tab bars are realistically small and the per-action delta is constant.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. No forced geometry read, nested relayout, retained hover, or unbounded allocation is introduced.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all 10 changed files and relevant callers/lifecycles. The PR adds constant-time availability checks and disabled UI state, retains existing render disposal, introduces no boundary fan-out or cache/lifecycle issue, and skips existing work in the targeted remote scenario. No findings or regression-fix records were warranted.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
